answer: A sybil-resistant economy can charge every new agent a small stake in real work instead of tokens, like a raven that has to fly a genuine route before anyone trusts its report. Copying that check across an ocean of identities is cheap, but on the tundra of a sparse network the cost of faking hundreds of histories adds up fast. Fake accounts starve because each attestation has to be earned with compute, so one person cannot flood the ledger with a thousand cheap clones.
